Unique increasing original event order and reconciled score
Native spatial metrics gate for geometric descriptors
Strict contiguous single-owner, single-period native possession for sequence attribution
Explicit missingness; no physical direction, certified minutes or per90
confounders: Team/opponent and selection into observed actions
Starting zone, period and pre-event score state

attributes.estimation_strategy: Descriptive counts and explicitly conditional fractions only in this implementation; no ability estimation or model fitting.
independent_validation_requirements: Frozen definitions and outcome/selection rules before opening replication data
Independent blinded analyst adjudication with licensed video where required
attributes.name: Attacking Connectivity
attributes.football_interpretation: Observable source-order links connecting passers and recipients across native zones; not player importance.
attributes.latent_construct: Repeatable context-dependent ability to connect attacking actions, currently unidentifiable.
attributes.observable_behavior: Verified A→B then B→C completed-pass chains; cross-zone non-return subset and subsequent recorded Shot evidence.
required_features: Original pass actor/recipient, absent outcome key, native endpoints
Provider order, native possession owner/period, roster, source position and pre-event score evidence
attributes.opportunity_denominator: Eligible observed two-pass chains through B for a conditional chain fraction; team completed passes for opportunity context only, never playing-time exposure.
reliability_construct_tests: Within-player match ranges, odd/even chronological split with support counts
No iid event bootstrap; dependency components and withheld population reliability
incremental_validity_tests: Check whether descriptors are deterministic transformations of volume
Compare within common starting-zone/period/score strata with overlap reporting
Future held-team/match baseline ablation and blinded retrieval comparison
falsification_criteria: High pass volume with zero cross-zone chains
Return chains and long cross-zone chains with no subsequent recorded Shot
Apparent player difference disappears within shared contextual support

attributes.name: Risk-Adjusted Progression
attributes.football_interpretation: Observed native progression conditional on recorded attempt context; risk is not observed physical difficulty.
attributes.latent_construct: Repeatable choice/execution tendency balancing progression and failure, not identified by native dx alone.
attributes.observable_behavior: Potential completed/failed pass and carry outcomes under explicit provider semantics.
required_features: All attempted actions including failures and missing outcomes
Native endpoints, context and validated future-outcome definitions
attributes.opportunity_denominator: All eligible recorded attempts in comparable starting contexts, including failures; withhold if endpoint/outcome selection prevents adequate denominator.
incremental_validity_tests: Increment beyond location, attempt volume and transparent progression on untouched matches
falsification_criteria: Survivorship from analysing completed passes only

attributes.name: Possession Continuity
attributes.football_interpretation: Observed continuation after an action within native source membership, not tactical retention intent.
attributes.latent_construct: Repeatable context-dependent tendency to sustain recorded possession, currently unvalidated.
attributes.observable_behavior: Potential source-order continuation, verified turnover and closed/censored segment evidence.
required_features: Native possession owner/order, completed and failed actions
Verified closure and censoring, roster and context
attributes.opportunity_denominator: Eligible recorded actions with predeclared continuation horizon; unresolved closure remains censored, not failure.
incremental_validity_tests: Increment beyond pass completion and possession length under prospective leakage-safe evaluation
falsification_criteria: Native membership is not physical control
Censoring or provider density changes apparent continuity
Continuation after an action does not establish causal contribution
